input: added retry with exponential backoff to the fetch client in the http module
fixed nil pointer dereference when the config file is missing at startup
renamed module storage to store, updating all import paths (breaking change)
bumped golangci-lint from 2.8.0 to 2.12.2 in CI
documented the cassette format matching rules in the spec directory
extracted duplicated pagination logic from three handlers into a shared helper
sped up the indexer by batching writes, roughly 4x fewer fsync calls
added table-driven tests covering the timeout and cancellation paths of the runner
fixed off-by-one in the sliding window rate limiter that allowed one extra request
added a --format json flag to the list command
removed the deprecated v1 config loader and its migration shims (breaking change)
reordered dockerfile layers so dependency downloads cache across builds
